summary: Review ML/AI evaluation pipelines for train-test contamination, repeated-entity leakage, preprocessing leakage, benchmark reuse and adaptive holdout overfitting.

must_inspect.why: Evaluation units that can share information must not cross train/test boundaries unintentionally.
false_positive_guards: A random split is not automatically leakage when observations are genuinely independent.

must_inspect.why: Repeated tuning on the same benchmark can turn a nominal holdout into development data.
false_positive_guards: Public benchmark use is not automatically invalid; calibrate the claim to the evaluation regime.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
